rulings.ruling: Ruling: representation; project retained; model value dropped from the fixture. The return has no Medicare wages, self-employment income or RRTA compensation, and the instructions say to skip those parts ("If you (and your spouse if filing a joint return) didn't have Medicare wages, skip Part I and go to Part II"; "didn't have self-employment income, skip Part II and go to Part III"; "didn't have RRTA compensation, skip Part III and go to Part IV", i8959 pp. 3–4), so the model left the threshold and subtraction lines blank. The project fills every part unconditionally with the filing-status threshold; the tax lines (7, 13, 17, 18) agree, and a blank is not the number zero, so neither value is evidence against the other. No change to the data.
